formal_proof_route: Braiding swaps the chosen exact pairing, making X a right dual of X*.
Uniqueness of right duals gives the objectwise inverse.
Braiding naturality plus evaluation and coevaluation mate identities prove naturality.
NatIso.ofComponents derives inverse naturality from objectwise isomorphisms.
